name: Teddy's Tees Inc
old_description: Teddy's Tees specializes in custom screen printing services, allowing us to print large batches of a single design quickly and consistently. Screen printing uses stencils and fabric paint to complete a design, and is one of the oldest methods used in apparel. Simple designs with only a few colors are typically used on screen printed items. We are happy to talk with you about the best design principles for screen printing, and how it can be more cost effective than other methods.
about:
Teddy's Tees operates from Concord, New Hampshire, where it has served the local community and surrounding areas for years. The company is a locally owned screen printing and embroidery service, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom screen printing, using stencils and fabric paint to produce large batches of single-color or few-color designs quickly and consistently. It also offers embroidery services, custom graphic tee production, and branding support, with in-house graphic artists assisting clients from concept to finished apparel.

Its customer base includes businesses, event organizers, and community organizations throughout the Concord region that need branded apparel, promotional items, or team uniforms. The company emphasizes clear communication throughout the design and production process.

Teddy's Tees positions itself on cost-effective screen printing for simple designs, the use of current embroidery techniques for professional results, and a hands-on, local approach that aims to exceed expectations with each order.
